name: QrGaloisField
src_typeComment: GF(256) arithmetic (primitive polynomial x^8+x^4+x^3+x^2+1 = 0x11D, generator element 2) — the finite field QR codes' Reed-Solomon error correction is defined over (ISO/IEC 18004 Annex A). Log/antilog tables turn multiplication into an add-then-lookup instead of a slow bit-by-bit polynomial multiply. Public (not internal) specifically so the Editor-folder self-test — a different default assembly in this no-asmdef project — can call it directly and verify it against a real published reference.

BuildGeneratorPolynomial
src_members.comment: Builds the generator polynomial for `degree` EC codewords: the product of (x + 2^i) for i = 0..degree-1, as coefficients ordered HIGH-degree-first (index 0 = the x^degree term, which is always 1 — monic). This ordering matches ComputeEcc's remainder algorithm below, which reads data codewords MSB-first.

src_members.sig: public static byte[] ComputeEcc(byte[] dataCodewords, int eccCount)
src_members.name: ComputeEcc
src_members.comment: Computes the Reed-Solomon EC codewords for one block of data codewords — polynomial long division of the data (shifted left by `eccCount` zero codewords) by the generator polynomial; the remainder IS the EC codewords. This is the standard systematic-encoding "LFSR simulation" algorithm.
